description: A labelled checkbox (DESIGN.md, Checkbox): a 20 box, TsuyaRadius.xs, a 1.5 px TsuyaColors.borderStrong boundary; checked, or (with tristate) mixed: accent-filled with a TsuyaColors.onAccent mark. The row (the box and label) is pressable and at least TsuyaSize.target tall.

constructors.description: A checkbox at value, labelled label.

params.name: value
params.description: Checked, unchecked, or (only with tristate) null for mixed.

params.name: onChanged
params.description: Called with the next value on a press; null disables it.

params.name: tristate
params.description: Allows value to be null (a mixed state), which the app sets, as on the web: a press never does. It checks a mixed checkbox (as the web's `<input type="checkbox">` does), and toggles a checked or an unchecked one.

params.name: focusNode
params.description: The node to track focus with, when the caller manages one.

params.name: autofocus
params.description: Focuses it as soon as it is built.
